137.name: Coaster
137.goal: Why won't this roller coaster go up!

steps.what: Tap the wig on the passenger at the back of the car
steps.why: The weight sign shows 240 kg. Pulling the rear passenger's wig off removes 10 kg instantly, and the target weight bar drops.

steps.what: Tap the wig on the middle passenger
steps.why: Same trick, second wig: another 10 kg gone. The coaster still can't climb, so keep going.

steps.what: Tap the wig on the front passenger
steps.why: Third wig, another 10 kg off. With the total weight down 30 kg the coaster finally crests the hill.
The coaster sails over the top and the polaroid screen appears. Level 137 cleared.
